business_type: speculative growth (pre-profitability roll-up in conversational AI)
moat_source: no durable moat demonstrated: 31.1% gross margin, no profitability at any scale to date, and big-tech competitors own the underlying model layer; the Fortune-100 customer list is an asset but not yet a moat

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: gross-margin transformation (31% today vs the 60%+ the scale thesis requires)
primary_model_risk: Margin structure: every scenario hinges on whether combined SoundHound-LivePerson gross margin can migrate from ~31% toward software economics. If it cannot, no revenue level produces meaningful FCF and even the bear case is generous. Revenue guidance is reaffirmed and sourced; the margin path is entirely assumption.
expectations_gap_key_variable: profitability arrival: at ~12x forward sales the market pays for the $500M combined-revenue story as if it comes with software margins; the reported 31.1% gross margin and -$26.7M quarterly EBITDA say the economics are unproven at any scale reached so far
top_5_bull_arguments: +52% y/y organic revenue growth with FY2026 guidance reaffirmed at $225-260M
LivePerson merger adds 25-of-Fortune-100 enterprise distribution and pushes combined revenue toward $500M
$216M cash, no debt, and the all-stock structure preserves the balance sheet
Agentic/voice AI is a real secular market and SoundHound is one of few independent pure plays
If margins transform with scale (bull case), IV ~$8.70 exceeds the current price - genuine optionality exists
top_5_bear_arguments: Two lossmaking companies do not arithmetically make a profitable one; integration costs land before synergies
31.1% gross margin is the tell: this is compute-heavy AI services, not high-margin software, so far
~$26.7M/quarter EBITDA burn against $216M cash gives roughly two years before dilution returns
Expected IV ($3.45) is half the price; probability-weighted returns are deeply negative
Big-tech voice/agentic stacks (Google, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI) can bundle at zero marginal price
thesis_breakers: LivePerson merger failing to close or closing on materially worse terms
Gross margin failing to exceed 40% by mid-2027 (transformation thesis stalling)
Cash below $120M without EBITDA-breakeven visibility (dilution imminent)
A Fortune-100 flagship customer churning to a big-tech stack
position_size_recommendation: 0%; lottery-ticket risk profile - if desired at all, only as a sub-0.5% option position, and only after the merger closes cleanly
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: lossmaking company, no meaningful ratios exist. DCF explicitly degraded: revenue guidance and cash are sourced; the margin path (the decisive variable) is entirely constructed - confidence_level low.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: +2.26% past week, +5.79% on the merger announcement day, 52-week range 5.83-22.17 (pass1/search) - the stock is 69% below its 52-week high. No verified historical multiple range captured.
